Class SecretResource

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.security.secrets.rest.SecretResource
@Path("/api/v1/secrets") @Produces("application/json") @Consumes("application/json") public class SecretResource extends Object
REST API for secret management. Endpoints: - POST /api/v1/secrets - Store a secret - GET /api/v1/secrets/{path} - Retrieve a secret - DELETE /api/v1/secrets/{path} - Delete a secret - GET /api/v1/secrets - List secrets - POST /api/v1/secrets/{path}/rotate - Rotate a secret - GET /api/v1/secrets/{path}/metadata - Get metadata only - GET /api/v1/secrets/health - Health check
